Abstract summary: Visual textures -- spatially homogeneous image regions containing repeated elements (e.g. a field of grass, the bark of a tree) -- are ubiquitous in visual scenes and provide important cues for recognizing and analyzing materials and objects. A number of existing texture models extract essential statistics from a single texture Out of scope: Visual texture generation.
title: Learning a Maximum Entropy Model for Visual Textures using Diffusion
